deliverables/colderwater-playground-devtools/final-cross-check-2026-09-27/harness/rewardkit-0.1.7-source/judges.py:467-494 (_arun_agent_individual) and runner.py:148-165 (mode semantics, reference copy only)
evidence: Scoring structure: tests/scoring.toml has gates render=0.0/constraints=0.0 and weighted scored functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2. Gates are exempt: gates/render/judge.toml:15 and gates/constraints/judge.toml:15 aggregation = "all_pass". Scored dimensions: (1) Functional - tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:3 mode = "individual" (template is batched; rewardkit 0.1.7 reference judges.py:467-494 runs each criterion in its own sequential agent call), so the 12 functional criteria are structurally independent; the prompt reinforces it at functional/prompt.md:9-11 ('## One criterion per session ... This session grades exactly ONE criterion ... The other functional criteria are graded in separate sessions') and :17 ('Once it succeeds, carry out your criterion's steps and continue after a failed leg so the report shows every leg'). Cross-criterion setup dependencies have fallbacks rather than cascades: :21 ('Where your criterion needs a job and no job can be opened ... use the seeded Product Designer job ... such a leg is not a skipped step'), hro_messaging ('if it never appears for him, which hro_candidate grades, use his seeded Data Analyst conversation instead'), hro_long_thread ('Mei Lin if Noor cannot send, which hro_messaging grades'). (2) Polish - polish/judge.toml:3 mode = "batched"; polish/prompt.md:12 'A blank or static shell or an observed failure of that check gives binary0 throughout. Otherwise judge each criterion independently and continue after failures.'; :24 'Do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row' plus a fallback ('open a job (if that fails, which Functional grades, use the seeded Product Designer job)'); criteria localise failures to their own row (hro_pol_live_board 'If no update arrives within 60 seconds ... this row is 0'; 'only if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards, record that and judge the other legs'; hro_pol_live_thread 'Mei Lin if Noor cannot send'). (3) Visual - visual/judge.toml:3 mode = "batched"; visual/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise grade every criterion independently with its five anchors and continue after failures.'; :14 'Do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row.' Negative check: grep for stop/first fail/halt/abort/'rest of'/'all other' over tests/scored/*/prompt.md, tests/scored/*/judge.toml and tests/app_context.md found no stop-at-first-failure instruction (the only 'abort' hit is hro_pol_failed_send's request-abort step). The only all-or-nothing rule in scored prompts is the global browser gate (polish:12, visual:12, functional:17, per-session), which the template also has and row 29 owns. Tool-failure handling is per-outcome (functional:35, polish:26, visual:20 'return binary0/Likert1 for the unobserved outcome ... Preserve every completed independent observation'), so a crash on one criterion does not zero completed ones. Lessons file cross-check for this row: lesson 9 (report each step; skipped step fails) is present in functional:31-33, polish:20-22, visual:16-18 and is scoped to 'that criterion', not the dimension; lesson 16 (no double penalty) is present in polish:24 and visual:14; no lesson pattern conflicts with independence. Broken-app probe: an app whose live updates never arrive fails hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread but the prompt's independence line keeps hro_pol_earlier_place, hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume scoreable. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that cannot open a new job (graded only in hro_intake_restart) still gets fair scoring elsewhere through the seeded Product Designer fallback, so one miss does not cascade. Scope of evidence: this is a prompt/config wording review; the private check-batched-independence-wording.py was not executed (manual application only), and no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'), so actual judge adherence is unmeasured; this row's requirement is the instruction wording, which is present.
